verdict.rationale: Pulumi provides the core pieces: an Automation API for headless, programmatic runs, `pulumi preview` for generating a diff without applying changes, and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop) generate infrastructure code and interact with Pulumi Cloud stacks, with Neo able to execute changes autonomously. Together these support an agent authoring code, running a headless plan, and surfacing a diff for human approval. missing for 10: no first-party documented end-to-end example combining Automation API + preview output specifically surfaced through the MCP server for agent-driven approval workflows, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that this exact agent-plan-approve loop works in practice.
